title: 藏经阁残简 第十二章 假意温和心如寒冰藏经阁残简 第十三章 道基无瑕文脉重生
slug: 残简道藏我靠修复古籍证道
content_zh:
顶层阁楼，光影斜落，尘静风轻。
昨夜沈砚夜搬废简、反手震退两名外门弟子，继而被刘松借机重罚禁足顶层。
不过短短一日间隔。
今日午后，阁楼入口脚步声轻响。
白衣少年踏步登临，身姿挺拔，衣袍鲜亮，周身凝气七层灵气淡淡外放。
正是陆明远。
他并非久念旧识、专程探望。
而是听闻昨夜西阁异动，得知两名外门弟子竟被“废人沈砚”击退，心中生出浓重疑虑，故而亲自前来窥伺试探。
三年蛰伏都安分守己，偏偏一夜之间生出异常。
这让本就对沈砚心存忌惮的陆明远，彻底放不下心。
阁楼木门虚掩。
陆明远抬眼望去，只见窗边立着一道清瘦灰影。
沈砚一身洗旧杂役长袍，安静伫立书架之间，背影沉寂，毫无波澜。
看上去，依旧是那个被道基破碎、彻底废掉的底层杂役。
陆明远眼底疑虑稍缓，缓步走入阁楼，目光居高临下，带着审视与淡漠。
他本就不信，一个废了三年的人，能一夜翻身。
昨夜之事，想来不过是那两名外门弟子实力太弱、疏于修行，丢人现眼罢了。
“听闻昨夜你在废书坪，倒是颇有动静。”
陆明远开口，声音平淡，看似随意问询，实则字字暗藏试探。
“沉寂三年不声不响，如今倒是敢对外门弟子出手了？”

话语温和表层之下，是赤裸裸的压制、审视与敲打。
他今日过来，一是确认沈砚是否藏力复苏，二是亲自打压，斩断对方任何崛起苗头。
三年来，沈砚沉默守阁、逆来顺受，从无半分反抗。
这也是陆明远最安心的地方。
可昨夜那一点异动，让他生出了一丝危机。
他绝不允许，自己亲手废掉的人，再有半点抬头的机会。
沈砚缓缓转身。
眉目清寂，神色淡然，不起丝毫涟漪。
若是换作旁人，被昔日仇敌登门审视试探，必然心绪起伏，或怒或惧。
但此刻，《破妄文章》悄然流转心神。
一眼通透，看破虚妄。
沈砚清晰看见陆明远眼底深处层层伪装：
表层是从容淡然、旧识闲谈。
content_en:
In the attic on the top floor, the light and shadow fall slantingly, the dust is quiet and the wind is gentle.
Last night, Shen Yan moved the waste slips and knocked back two outer disciples with his backhand, and Liu Song took the opportunity to severely punish and ban him from the top floor.
It’s just a short one day interval.
This afternoon, there was a soft sound of footsteps at the entrance to the attic.
The young man in white stepped forward, with a tall and straight posture, bright robes, and seven layers of condensed spiritual energy all over his body.
It was Lu Mingyuan.
He didn't miss his old acquaintance for a long time and made a special trip to visit.
But after hearing about the unusual movements in the West Pavilion last night and learning that the two outer disciples were actually repelled by "The Wasted Man Shen Yan", he had serious doubts in his heart, so he came to spy and test them in person.
He had been sleeping peacefully for three years, but something strange happened overnight.
This made Lu Mingyuan, who was already wary of Shen Yan, completely unable to let go.
The wooden door to the attic is ajar.
Lu Mingyuan looked up and saw a thin gray figure standing by the window.
Shen Yan was wearing a washed-out handyman robe, standing quietly among the bookshelves, his back silent and unruffled.
It seems that he is still the same low-level handyman whose Daoji was shattered and completely destroyed.
The doubts in Lu Mingyuan's eyes eased slightly, and he walked slowly into the attic, his eyes condescending, with scrutiny and indifference.
He didn't believe that a person who had been disabled for three years could turn around overnight.
What happened last night was just that the two outer disciples were too weak and neglected their cultivation, so they were embarrassed.
"I heard that you were in Feishuping last night, and there was quite a stir."
Lu Mingyuan spoke in a calm voice, seemingly asking casually, but in fact every word contained a hidden test.
"You have been silent for three years, but now you dare to take action against the outer disciples?"
Beneath the gentle surface of words, there is naked suppression, scrutiny and beating.
He came here today, firstly to confirm whether Shen Yan had recovered his hidden strength, and secondly, to suppress him personally and cut off any signs of the opponent's rise.
For three years, Shen Yan remained silent and resigned, never resisting at all.
This is also where Lu Mingyuan feels most at ease.
But that little change last night gave him a hint of crisis.
He would never allow the person he had destroyed with his own hands to have the slightest chance to raise his head again.
Shen Yan turned around slowly.
His eyebrows were quiet and his expression was indifferent, without any ripples.
If it were anyone else, and being inspected and tested by former enemies, they would definitely feel ups and downs, either angry or fearful.
But at this moment, "Breaking Delusion Articles" quietly circulated in my mind.
A clear glance can see through illusions.
Shen Yan clearly saw the layers of disguise deep in Lu Mingyuan's eyes:
On the surface, it is calm and indifferent, chatting with old acquaintances.
